verdict.summary: The feature is correctly default-off, dependency-neutral, and narrowly reuses PodStore's cached fail-closed accessible set. Source decisions preserve input order, return only the intersection of declared and readable named graphs, sort/deduplicate that subset, and skip empty or wholly unauthorized declarations. The focused tests exercise the real materialized WAC path, partial authorization, mode/session separation, reserved-principal rejection, pre-materialization behavior, ordering, and duplicate declarations. Public API documentation and the access-control skill are updated, and the MPC/security language remains appropriately caveated as plan-time-only, caller-asserted, semi-honest, and externally unaudited.
